notes.title: Build v1.2 Animations, Custom Background Tracks....
notes.content:
We’ve been working hard to improve your drumming experience, and here’s what’s new in the latest build:

🎵 New Features
Import Custom Soundtracks:

Run the game if you haven’t already, and a CustomSoundTracks folder will be automatically generated.
Navigate to the game’s executable directory and drop your sound files into the new folder.
Restart the game and jam along with your favorite tracks!
Camera Options:
Added 3 new camera views to enhance your perspective and immersion.

Improved Animations:

Kick pedal now features proper animation.
Cymbals and hi-hat have been given realistic motion for a better visual experience.
🚀 Upcoming Update Highlights
Here’s what’s on the horizon:

AI Band Members to accompany you during performances.
Concert Stage with a lively crowd to amp up the energy!
Audio Effects to simulate an authentic live concert environment.
A Control System for Drum Intensity for dynamic and expressive drumming.
Thank you for your support—keep rocking, and we’ll see you on the stage!
